messages:
Ana: quick flag — account health dashboard shows NorthBeacon at 'at-risk' for renewal (NPS dropped, weekly active orgs -22%). thinking we need a short retention play to re-engage before renewal window.
Mike: +1. can we get a 7-day tactical sequence? high-level: audit usage, targeted enablement, quick wins, capture blockers, exec touch. who owns outreach cadence?
Ana: I can run outreach to product owners. need a concise checklist we can run through with CSM + SE. suggest focus on: billing surprises, performance regressions, feature adoption gaps.
Lee: will help with technical triage. can provide a short health pack for them to run: ```1) run /metrics export for last 30d
2) surface top 3 dropped endpoints
3) check model routing policies for canary fallbacks```
Sarah: propose an enablement session: 30 min surgery on prompt templates + routing. offer a one-time onboarding micro-consult (no charge) to surface value quickly. if they engage, push renewal to full-rate; if they decline, propose phased reduction instead of full cancel.
Mike: ok, I'll draft a 7-day checklist and an email template. suggested sequence:
- Day 0: audit + Ana outreach
- Day 1: technical triage call (Lee)
- Day 2: enablement surgery (Sarah)
- Day 4: follow-up + exec note with usage uplift targets
- Day 6: retention decision summary + renewal recommendation
Ana: also want to capture their product feedback loop. add quick survey after Day 2: 3 Qs (ease of use, performance, support). embed link to docs and ask for sample prompts.
Lee: putting together a short snippet for them to copy-paste into their workspace (will post in #devex after this). one ask: can we offer a temporary rate-limiter increase to let them ramp without errors? billing ok with that?
Mike: finance okay with a one-week trial bump if we log the change and TTL it. I'll coordinate.
RetentionBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 7 days — /remind @Ana to post retention summary for NorthBeacon at <#customer-success> (auto-created ticket: RB-4921)
Ana: thumbs up. who can own the post-mortem if we don't convert? want clear next-steps: downgrade path (reduced capacity + lower price) or offboard checklist.
Sarah: I can own the downgrade/offboard template. will draft and share by EOD.
Ana: perfect. tagging @Mike @Lee @Sarah — please add any templates to the thread. I’ll send the Day 0 outreach in 30m. :calendar:
